data.summary: Approve with notes: confirm the items below.

requirements.text: Door closers shall have a minimum warranty period of 10 years from Substantial Completion.
Exit devices shall have a minimum warranty period of 5 years from Substantial Completion.
Mortise locksets shall have a minimum warranty period of 10 years from Substantial Completion.
Cylindrical locksets shall have a minimum warranty period of 7 years from Substantial Completion.
Power door operators shall have a minimum electronics warranty period of 2 years from Substantial Completion.
Power door operators shall have a minimum mechanical warranty period of 5 years from Substantial Completion.
Electrified locksets shall have a minimum electronics warranty period of 2 years from Substantial Completion.
Electrified locksets shall have a minimum mechanical warranty period of 5 years from Substantial Completion.
Other electrified hardware components shall have a minimum warranty period of 3 years from Substantial Completion.
Other mechanical hardware shall have a minimum warranty period of 5 years from Substantial Completion.
All hardware shall comply with CSA Heavy Duty standard.
All hardware shall be Grade 1.
Lock cylinders shall be Abloy of Canada cylinders with no substitutions allowed.
Hinges shall be from approved manufacturers: Stanley, Monthard, Hager, or McKinney.
Pivots shall be from approved manufacturers: Dorma or Yale-Corbin (Rixson).
Door stops, swing stops, and holders shall be from approved manufacturers: Rixson, Dorma, Hagar, Gallery, Ives, Glynn–Johnson, or Rockwood.
Flush bolts shall be from approved manufacturers: Trimco, Ives, Glynn-Johnson, Gallery, or Rockwood.

value: Corbin ML2000 series with LWA lever
requirements.text: Mortise locks and trim shall be from approved series: Corbin ML2000 series with LWA lever, Schlage L9000 series with 03B lever, or Sargent 8200 series with LNJ lever.
Cylindrical locks shall be from approved series: Corbin CL3300 series, Schlage ND series with Vandlguard, Sargent 10 line, or LSDA-800 series Grade 2 levers.

value: Schlage CO 100 x less cylinder x KP x 626
requirements.text: Push button code locks shall be from approved models: Schlage CO 100 x less cylinder x KP x 626 or Sargent KP Series.
Stand‑alone alarm locks shall be Detex EAX500 or Alarm Lock Pilfergard PG21.
Dead bolt locks shall be from approved models: Corbin DL4000 series, Sargent 4800 series, Schlage L600 series (mortise) or ILCO 4514.25.1.04.04.5 (cylindrical).
Magnetic locks, if required, shall be Securitron M Series.
Exit devices shall be from approved series: Von Duprin 98XP, 99XP, 33A; Sargent 8000; or Corbin ED5000.
Door closers shall be from approved models: LCN 4040XP Series x 689 finish, Sargent 351, Corbin 6200, or Norton 7700.

value: LCN 4630/4640 Series - Auto Equalizer x 689 finish
requirements.text: Power operators shall be from approved models: LCN 4630/4640 Series - Auto Equalizer x 689 finish, Record-8100 Series, or Record-Simple Swing units; no substitutions allowed.
Electrified exit devices shall be from approved QEL series: Corbin, Sargent, or Von Duprin.
Electrified hold‑open devices shall be from approved series: Simplex RSG or Edwards 1500.
Electrified lock boxes shall be ProxSafe flex key management system.
Fire department key and card tube deposit lockbox shall be Abloy Protec.
